top_signals.title: Swats: Saudi Derivatives Push Targets Global Investors
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia is seeking to deepen its capital markets, by making it cheaper and easier to trade derivatives. The changes aim to attract more investors and trading firms by providing tools to hedge positions and manage risk. Eric Swats, Senior Executive Officer at Rasmala Investment Bank spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the reforms in the Saudi markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Capital Hike to Cut Broker Numbers Under Philippine SEC Plan
top_signals.summary: The Philippines’ stock market operator sees a reduction in stock brokerage firms should the Securities and Exchange Commission go ahead with a plan to increase capitalization requirements.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Indonesia’s Rupiah, Bonds Edge Lower as Investors Eye Protest in Jakarta
top_signals.summary: The Indonesian rupiah and government bonds slipped for a third day on Thursday, with investors keeping an eye on whether a small protest in Jakarta may balloon into a larger demonstration.
